rows.label: Halt new exposure
rows.explanation: Blocks new risk-increasing work while recovery stays visible
invariants: cannot disengage through this Product control

rows.label: Enter READ_ONLY
rows.explanation: Transitions the canonical system posture to READ_ONLY only
invariants: ADVISORY, VALIDATE_ONLY, and live modes are not exposed by this Product control

rows.label: Set component desired state
rows.explanation: Requests a bounded component lifecycle state

rows.label: Pause intake
rows.explanation: Pauses admitted proposal intake; resume is not exposed by this Product control

rows.label: Restart managed engine supervisor
rows.explanation: Restarts only the managed dependency-root runtime graph

rows.label: Execute recovery
rows.explanation: Executes only an accepted risk-reducing plan

rows.label: Acknowledge incident
rows.explanation: Acknowledges attention without clearing root cause
